purpose: Expected artifact contract for the reproducible V1 demo harness.

hashes.scope: Every regular file in the run directory except manifest.json itself; command stdout/stderr are included.

limitations: A generated run is evidence of this tool invocation, not a fabrication-readiness verdict.
This harness does not materialize or claim a native PhiCad revision.
The engine and verifier may report failures; capture success is not design success.
